meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好的 Dial 渠道增加一个电话号码，同一个 NanoClaw 安装就能用多个号码接收短信和 AI 语音来电。每个号码是独立的线程式线路，回复从收到消息的那个号码发出，已有线路不受影响。
howto.when: 当 Dial 渠道已安装、操作者想再加一个号码（比如个人线加客服线）时接管。若 Dial 尚未安装，需先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 再加一个号码 +14155550123
say.note: 先检查 Dial 是否已装，再引导选号。

say.text: 把这个新号码接到 ag-support 这个 agent 组
say.note: 会为该号码创建线路并完成接线。

say.text: 这条新线路设成 strict，只有已知用户能发消息
say.note: strict 只放行已知用户，public 则谁都能联系。

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an existing Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Each number is its own threaded line; replies leave from the number that received the message, and existing lines stay unchanged.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an extra number, e.g. a personal line plus a support line. If Dial is not installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.text: Add another number to my Dial channel: +14155550123
say_en.note: Checks Dial is installed, then picks the number.

say_en.text: Wire this new number to agent group ag-support
say_en.note: Creates the line and the wiring.

say_en.text: Set this new line to strict so only known users can text it
say_en.note: strict allows known users; public lets anyone.
